question:
I wanted to install dbt on my wsl, but it keeps downloading only the old version enter image description here.

Tried to upgrade using

pip install --upgrade dbt-<adapter>

but it doesnt work. While upgrating I see this log:

Using cached dbt_bigquery_0.21.1-py3-none-any.whl (30 kb)

Not sure how to solve it. I dont have any projects yet.
title: Cannot download the newest version of dbt
answer:
pip keeps a cache of downloaded objects, which can mess with version resolution sometimes. You can try the --no-cache-dir option to tell it to ignore its cache:

pip install --upgrade dbt-bigquery --no-cache-dir

Or better yet, use a version specifier:

pip install --upgrade dbt-bigquery==1.5.0 --no-cache-dir
